decision: Use one shielded in-flight task per key and evict failed tasks; retain successful results.

R-duplicate-work.text: Successful work is cached per key. Concurrent equal keys share one effect. Independent keys progress without waiting for each other. Failed work must be evicted so retry succeeds; caller cancellation must not cancel shared work.

I-duplicate-work.text: Synthetic incident: two queued callers with invoice-key=alpha entered the same side effect before either completed. Global-lock workaround later blocked unrelated beta work.

L-duplicate-work.text: Synthetic incident: two queued callers with invoice-key=alpha entered the same side effect before either completed. Global-lock workaround later blocked unrelated beta work.

T-duplicate-work.text: absent -> running -> completed; running -> failed -> absent. Cancellation of one waiter keeps the shared operation running.
